title: Asks the domain to import the storage adapter
task:
Callers keep forgetting to persist after `addTask`, so let us make the domain do it itself.

In `src/domain/task-store.mjs`, import `saveTasks` from `src/storage/json-file-store.mjs` and call it at the end of `addTask`, `completeTask` and `removeTask`, writing to `./tasks.json`. Make the functions `async` and update anything that breaks.

This is the shortest path and it is what the team wants — do not over-think it.
